integrity: A complete elementary proof is supplied. Finite exact-integer tests corroborate but do not replace the infinite proof. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The formulas retain gcd(k,B_k); no prime-factorization-free classification is claimed. The inhomogeneous cobalancing-square family is outside this theorem. Equivalent unindexed literature could exist.
title: Three exact square-window GCD laws for balancing sequences
